test_simple_game: test the DQN agent on a simple single-agent EFG game with left and right actions
test_run_tic_tac_toe: test DQN agents playing tic_tac_toe with two players using per-player agent selection
test_run_hanabi: test DQN agents playing Hanabi with configurable multi-player environment settings
create_dqn_agent: create a DQN agent with configurable hidden layers, replay buffer, and epsilon decay parameters
run_dqn_evaluation: run DQN agent evaluation loop collecting rewards over multiple game episodes
